items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea
items.claim: The text says Moses stretched out his hand over the sea.
items.mechanism: gesture by Moses comes just before the sea returns (narrative sequence)

items.quote: the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared
items.claim: The text says the sea returned to its full force at daybreak.
items.mechanism: waters flow back in the morning after Moses' gesture

items.quote: and the Egyptians fled against it
items.claim: The text says the Egyptians fled toward the returning waters.
items.mechanism: the returning waters cut off the Egyptians' escape

items.quote: and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea
items.claim: The text says the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.
items.place: in the midst of the sea
items.mechanism: the text credits God with the defeat, carried out through the returning sea
